Test Case Title: TC0001_ Check the completion rate card in the podcast
Description: Validate For admins and content publishers the completion card should be displayed in the top right of the podcast, and the completion percentage should be calculated based on total number of learners assigned versus total number learners completed the podcast
Precondition: The podcast should be assigned to x number of learners
Steps:
1. Log in as admin / Content publisher
2. Navigate to Hey sales module
3. Open any Podcast
4. Check the Completion rate card
Expected Result:
1. User should be able to login in successfully
2. Hey sales module should render successfully
3. User should be able to open / create any Podcast
4. The completion rate card should be displayed with respection percentage
Actual Result: For admins and content publishers the completion card is displayed in the top right of the simulation, and the completion percentage is calculated based on total number of learners assigned versus total number learners completed the podcast

Test Case Title: TC0002_Check the completion rate card if the completion is 0%
Description: Validate When no learners have completed the podcast or not started the podcast the percentage should be 0 and the sub text should be 0 out of x number of learners have completed
Precondition: The podcast should be assigned to 10 number of learners and no learner should complete the podcast
Steps:
1. Create a podcast
2. Assign the simulation to 10 learners
3. Check the completion rate card
Expected Result:
1. Admin / content publisher should be able to create a podcast
2. User should be able to assign 10 learners to the podcast
3. If no user has completed the podcast, on the completion card the percentage should be 0 and the sub text should read 0 of 10 learners have completed
Actual Result: When no learners have completed the podcast or not started the call the percentage is 0 and the sub text is 0 out of x number of learners have completed

2. Open My courses
3. Start the podcast and complete
4. Repate the same for Learner B
5. Now Login as admin
6. Check the completion card in admin view

4. User should be able to login as Learner B and should be able to start a podcast and successfully complete it

Actual Result: When a certain number of learners have complete the podcast [eg: 2 learners], the percentage is updated respectively. And the sub text reads X out of x number of learners have completed
